description: This file defines an interface for representing the minimum repayment schedule details for a loan product in the Fineract system. It specifies methods to retrieve various properties related to repayment schedules, interest calculations, and grace periods.

methods.name: getCurrencyData
methods.description: Returns the currency data associated with the loan product.

methods.name: getGraceOnInterestCharged
methods.description: Returns the number of periods interest is charged but not yet payable (interest grace).

methods.name: getGraceOnInterestPayment
methods.description: Returns the number of periods interest payment is delayed (interest payment grace).

methods.name: getGraceOnPrincipalPayment
methods.description: Returns the number of periods principal payment is delayed (principal payment grace).

methods.name: getRecurringMoratoriumOnPrincipalPeriods
methods.description: Returns the number of periods of moratorium on principal payment.

methods.name: getNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the nominal interest rate per period as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getInterestPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the frequency type of interest periods, e.g., monthly or quarterly.

methods.name: getAnnualNominalInterestRate
methods.description: Returns the annual nominal interest rate as a BigDecimal.

methods.name: getInterestMethod
methods.description: Returns the interest calculation method employed.

methods.name: getInterestCalculationPeriodMethod
methods.description: Returns the method used for interest calculation periods.

methods.name: isAllowPartialPeriodInterestCalculation
methods.description: Indicates whether partial period interest calculation is permitted.

methods.name: getRepayEvery
methods.description: Returns the frequency of repayments in terms of periods.

methods.name: getReaymentPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the frequency type of repayment periods.

methods.name: getNumberOfRepayments
methods.description: Returns the total number of repayments.

methods.name: getAmortizationMethod
methods.description: Returns the amortization method used for loan repayment.

methods.name: getGraceOnArrearsAgeing
methods.description: Returns the grace period on arrear aging.

methods.name: getDaysInMonthType
methods.description: Returns the type of days in month calculation method.

methods.name: getDaysInYearType
methods.description: Returns the days-in-year type used for interest calculations.

methods.name: isInterestRecognitionOnDisbursementDate
methods.description: Indicates whether interest is recognized on the disbursement date.

methods.name: getDaysInYearCustomStrategy
methods.description: Returns the custom strategy for calculating days in a year.
